description.value:
Your exocortex connects to a commercial robot companion called a drone that accompanies you on your adventures and follows your neural commands to the best of its abilities. (See Robot Companions for more information.) In addition to the commercial customization all robot companions receive, your drone gains two additional commercial customizations. You control your drone with your thoughts at a range of up to 150 feet; only you can operate, control, and Repair your drone. If your drone is ever beyond your range of control, it can't perform any actions. During your daily preparations, you automatically Repair your drone, restoring it to its maximum Hit Points. You can also restore your drone to maximum Hit Points by spending 1 hour to Repair your drone (or 10 minutes if you have Quick Repair). You can further customize and advance your drone by taking feats.

If your drone is reduced to 0 Hit Points, rather than being destroyed, it collapses and initiates an emergency reboot, shutting down until repaired. While shut down, it becomes immune to damage, can't be harmed, and can't take any actions. At the end of 1 minute, it's restored to 1 Hit Point.

By spending a little extra time, you can direct your drone to enact a more complex plan. You can spend 2 actions to Command instead of 1 when commanding your drone; your drone can then use an additional action (normally 3 actions, rather than 2).

You can @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Modify] your adjacent drone, its unarmed attacks, and any weapons it wields. The drone counts as armor for the purposes of Modify. The drone's unarmed attacks count as weapons for the purposes of Modify. You gain the following new mods.

  • Desperate Repair (drone exocortex): Your drone gains temporary Hit Points equal to your level plus your Intelligence modifier until the end of your next turn.

  • Killbot (drone exocortex): Your drone gains a +2 status bonus to damage rolls. If your drone's Strikes deal more than one weapon damage die, the status bonus increases to 2 per weapon damage die, to a maximum +8 status bonus to damage rolls with four weapon damage dice.
